program.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the book behind the flower.
requirements.source_phrase: Move the book behind the flower

outcomes.description: The book is moved behind the flower.
outcomes.target: The book is visibly positioned behind the flower, with the flower in front of it.
outcomes.reference: Compare the book’s and flower’s relative positions and occlusion in the edited image.

nodes.question: In the EDITED image, is the book visibly positioned behind the flower, with the flower in front of it?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if the EDITED image shows the flower occluding the book where they overlap, establishing that the book is behind it. Fail if the EDITED image does not show this front-to-back relationship, including if it retains the SOURCE relationship or the objects do not visibly overlap enough to establish depth. Unknown only if the relevant relationship cannot be observed.
nodes.binding: The book must be behind the flower, with the flower in front.
nodes.source_quote: Move the book behind the flower
nodes.endpoint: The edited image visibly places the book behind the flower, with the flower in front of it.
nodes.necessity: The instruction explicitly requests moving the book behind the flower; without the specified front-to-back relationship, that requested spatial change is incomplete.
